'''Jaga Badur''' was a [[Rawanikola]] [[Homeworld|from]] [[Jakku]],<ref name="BBH" /> a [[desert]] [[planet]] where<ref name="TFA VD">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="TFA Date">{{FilmDate|VII}}</ref> Badur walked through [[Niima Outpost]] as the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] dismounted her [[Rey's speeder|speeder]] with salvage collected from the [[Star Destroyer]]<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref> ''[[Inflictor]]''.<ref name="TFA VD" />

Later that [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="GEDates">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]] to [[34 ABY]].</ref> Badur hid in a building in [[Black Spire Outpost]] on the planet [[Batuu]] while there was an outstanding [[bounty]] of 575 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] on the Rawanikola's head for counterfeiting, outstanding debts, evading [[Prisoner|arrest]], and [[Thief|shoplifting]] toys from the [[City|outpost's]] [[Black Spire Outpost Market|market]]. During the [[First Order]]'s [[Battle of Batuu|occupation]] of Batuu, the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]] assigned the bounty to an outpost visitor who used a [[thermal scanner]] to find Badur's hiding place, which they then reported to the local [[Guildmaster's Hideout]] to claim the reward.<ref name="BBH" /> Badur wore a [[Color|gray]] mask and brown [[Clothing|robes]].<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jaga Badur first appeared in the [[2015]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']].<ref name="TFA" /> The character was then identified in ''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]'', an augmented reality [[Star Wars video games|video game]] launched at [[Wikipedia:Walt Disney World|Walt Disney World]]<ref name="BBH" /> on [[July 27]], [[2022]].<ref name="DPB Launching">{{DPB|url=2022/07/magicbandplus-launching-july-27-at-walt-disney-world|text=MagicBand+ Launching July 27 at Walt Disney World|nolive=1}}</ref>
